parent.comparison: immutable cached first-attempt scores; no fresh parent repeat in this matrix

arms.pipeline: shared source-validated extraction, cards only, existing combined-contract nano finalizer
the identical extractor capture/cards plus bounded deterministic operations, same finalizer

sharedExtraction.input: exact parent question/date and complete unchanged retained semantic96KB context; no fresh retrieval
sharedExtraction.schema: one versioned JSON object containing cards and optional bounded operation plans; shared by both arms
sharedExtraction.cardReferences: source alias, exact quote and small tag; host derives turnID/source digest and uniquely matching UTF-8 range
sharedExtraction.sourceDerivedFields: host resolves the source alias and unique exact quote occurrence, then derives source digest, byte range, speaker and statement date from authenticated parent source
sharedExtraction.validation: reject foreign source aliases, empty/oversized/absent or ambiguously matching quotes, duplicate cards, unknown schema keys and oversized output; validate every card before rendering; final context overflow fails that arm without trimming
sharedExtraction.relations: model-derived relevance and tags are explicitly labeled interpretations, not proven facts
sharedExtraction.retainedDistinctions: user experience, plan, hypothetical/example, assistant assertion, explicit event date, statement date, uncertainty and conflicting states
sharedExtraction.prohibitions: no gold/annotation/category/outcome inputs; no benchmark-specific examples, exception list, query rewrite or scorer-guided repair

operations.execution: pure bounded interpreter; no arbitrary code or model-provided computed values
operations.operands: only admitted card IDs and exact quoted literals; host parses bare decimals when unit is null, dimension-compatible explicit units otherwise, and complete ISO YYYY-MM-DD dates only
operations.limits: at most16 independent operations,32 referenced cards; no operation-to-operation references, finite bounded exact-decimal arithmetic
operations.ambiguityPolicy: unknown/unsupported operations or approximate/conflicting operands yield explicit unresolved results; no relative-date inference, automatic use of statement dates, event-date filter or semantic deduplication; distinct literals use exact byte identity
operations.scopeLimit: arithmetic is deterministic after operands are chosen; card relevance, grouping and event/state interpretation remain model-derived

finalizer.contextLimit: each arm at most16384UTF8 bytes total; B adds results to the same complete card rendering and fails on overflow without trimming
finalizer.isolation: A receives neither operation plans nor interpreter output; B adds only interpreter results; existing profile unchanged and exact per-stage request identities

judge.qualification: native prompt/reduction through unpinned Gateway alias and16-token cap; not official pinned10-token reproduction

failurePolicy.scoreZero: authenticated extractor/reader/judge failure, malformed/truncated extraction, invalid quote schema or unavailable required stage
failurePolicy.unsupportedOperation: explicit unresolved result, not a failed transport and never a fabricated number
failurePolicy.noRepair: no retry, repair call, selective replacement or original-context fallback
failurePolicy.denominator: all100 planned per arm; complete only when every case has an authenticated terminal success/failure; never-admitted remain separately unattempted
failurePolicy.money: preserve all first captures and occupied reservations; shared extractor charged once physically and fully attributed to each stand-alone arm comparison

serviceQualification.order: first six lexically sorted opaque IDs in pinned private selection
serviceQualification.criterion: transport/usage/capture and enforcement of declared schema/failure handling only; never answer correctness
serviceQualification.reuse: all first canary captures retained in terminal100; no accuracy-dependent expansion
serviceQualification.stop: systematic client rejection, broken custody/accounting or zero successful physical responses in a wave; stop new admission and drain

reporting: all planned arms, wins/losses/ties, per-category counts, complete/failed/unattempted cases, unique physical calls, known cost, unresolved reservations and stage latency

developmentPromotionRule.tieBreak: higher recorded correct count, then lower attributed exposure, then A
developmentPromotionRule.inference: development selection gate only; two adaptively proposed arms are not a confirmatory superiority test

costForecast.rateSource: frozen prior nano profile, not current external pricing
costForecast.qualification: assumed output/card token volumes; excludes native indexing because exact parent context reused; actual conservative reservations may exceed forecast; B interpreter results may raise final input above the shared3500-token assumption

dispatchPrerequisites: independent implementation review and synthetic source/quote/arithmetic/old-request parity tests

freeze source/schema/prompts/existing profile hashes, full100 logical matrix and all extractor physical requests before first new output; construct and freeze downstream exact physical plans from authenticated preceding captures before each stage dispatch
root-owned explicit campaign authority, remaining allocation, bounded transport/capture and canary manifest
unchangedStudy: The separately frozen full500 candidate and study remain unchanged; no closed400 source/answer access for this development design.
